notes.title: Animality - Mini Games Update
notes.content:
Animality now has 2 mini games that are available, you can play 


Animality Arabian Derby:

Cost to play: 100 Coins
Victory Coins: 300 Coins

Select an animal or demon and they will race against each other, if your animal wins then you will be rewarded with 300 coins


Animality Duck Hunt:

Cost to play: 50 Coins
Victory Coins: 250 Coins

Try to find 3 ducks amongst the 500 rampaging creatures, find all 3 and be awarded with 250 coins

notes.title: Achievements Update!
notes.content:
Hey guys

I hope you have been enjoying the game thus far, i am really surprised at some of the scores you guys have managed to hit!

The latest update to ANIMALITY adds over 250 Steam achievements to the game, so update your clients and begin achievement hunting, best of luck to all of you

Thanks 

~Lee

notes.title: We Are Live!
notes.content:
The day is here, thanks so much for supporting us during the games development and a special thank you to all the people who purchased the Groupees DLC bundle, all your keys should be going into your account within the next 2 hours

I am excited to see what kind of high scores you guys can reach, i will be doing my best to beat you on the leaderboards!

There is a lot planned for ANIMALITY so please watch this space, i will keep you up to date with new features

Also if you have managed to read through this entire announcement, as a special offer i am giving away a free key to each of the first 50 people who send an e-mail to:

animalitypromotion@phatphrogstudios.com

I will also give away DLC keys to anyone who makes a YouTube video on ANIMALITY and sends an e-mail with the link to the same e-mail above 

Thanks guys, happy running!

~Lee
